candidate: H51a low-bit global dense frames plus node-addressed DCT carrier capacity ceiling

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H50 proves target-acquired shared directions and row-local coordinates are useful, but two row-fixed directions leave an angular bottleneck. Store two full global low-bit frames once, and let every node/row query them through a procedural fast orthogonal carrier and private diagonal fields.

scientific_question: Can two charged global 768x768 low-bit frames, addressed through node-private procedural DCT carriers and local diagonal/amplitude coordinates, represent the dominant top-16 PCs of all six 239-state MLP paths under one percent deployment bytes?

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: independent mean of all 239 states for the optimistic capacity ceiling
frozen_inventory.pc_weighting: eigenvalue normalized within each node's top-16 set

frozen_decoder.weight_formula: W_n=W0_n+diag(a_n)[C_n0 diag(d_n0) R0 + C_n1 diag(d_n1) R1]
frozen_decoder.seed_weight: exact step-zero matrix, reproducible from the matched model initialization and not charged as learned state
frozen_decoder.global_frame_zero: one learned 768x768 frame deployed as signed int8 plus one FP16 scale per row
frozen_decoder.global_frame_one: one learned 768x768 frame deployed as signed int4 plus one FP16 scale per row
frozen_decoder.carrier: four vertically stacked orthonormal DCT-II blocks with deterministic node/carrier row permutations and row/column sign flips
frozen_decoder.carrier_persistent_state: none; regenerate from node identity and seed
frozen_decoder.local_coordinates: one FP16 row-amplitude vector a_n of length 3072 and two FP16 diagonal vectors d_nk of length 768 for every deployed layer/role node

optimistic_capacity_fit.targets: all 96 unit PCs: six nodes times top 16 components
optimistic_capacity_fit.temporary_coordinates: independent a,d0,d1 for each target PC; alternatives along one manifold, not simultaneous deployed state
optimistic_capacity_fit.frame_initialization: two independent deterministic orthogonal DCT-II frames with frozen seed signs/permutations
optimistic_capacity_fit.local_initialization: a=1; d0 and d1 deterministic Gaussian with standard deviation 1/sqrt(768)
optimistic_capacity_fit.objective: mean over nodes of eigenvalue-weighted squared cosine between generated and target PCs
optimistic_capacity_fit.quantization: per-row symmetric signed int8 qmax=127 for R0 and signed int4 qmax=7 for R1

controls.unquantized_fitted_frames: same final FP32 frames and local coordinates before low-bit quantization
controls.procedural_unfitted_frames: initial deterministic DCT frames with optimally trained local coordinates but no learned global orientation
controls.single_int8_frame: zero the int4 branch after fitting
controls.fixed_blockfht_reference: use sealed 1% capture near 0.009993 as the random-coordinate reference
